text: F02.2 provides an operator-only PostgresOrganizationCatalog adapter and atomic createDataset (scientific row, ExplicitOnly placement, creator stewardship, event and retry receipt in one transaction). The packaged server requires explicit reviewed bootstrap; legacy repository create is refused afterward. F02.3 must provide the supported public creation/administration/transfer/move/recovery commands and reviewed runtime privileges. Public organization receipts must state LocalOnly/pending/durable truthfully as ADR004 integration advances; internal local receipt fields are not proof of independent durability.
